label: Ruth Callan's first greeting — the quiet-beat offer

purpose.value: Ruth walks the hero down her lane and offers the de-escalation she offers everyone: nothing has ever come through the Fungal Field gate, so there is nothing out there that needs fighting.

emotionalProgression.note: Farmhouse dogs, harvest news, a lost traveler pointed home — her belt at its best is boring.
She frames standing down as the reasonable compromise between neighbors, the way she settles fence disputes.
He accepts her 'local intelligence' gratefully and asks which lane is quietest — meaning easiest to slip through; she walks the rest of the way in silence.

notes: Grounded bewilderment, patrol register: her flaw is the engine — she keeps offering compromises he cannot even hear as offers. She knows the Fungal Field is commons, but this early scene keeps to the gate fact; the waves on the Glass are gardeners, not armies. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
